Kiwix uses checked scalar and slice conversions for signed integers, floats,
and variable-width fields. Bulk Read methods stage initialized bytes in
bounded chunks. Floating-point conversions preserve raw bits. The public
method names and feature declarations are retained. The crate forbids unsafe
Rust.
